additional_info.subject: ID0483684-DC/Si-D/FR-[Y2/S2 313522141002] Fault report – Charger CRM:03056001105
additional_info.body:
Dear Malek,
Thank you for contacting eMobility Support.
Following your report, and after checking the charger, we see that these errors appeared under error code 1, which is related to the mainbreaker.
After that, we see that the charger resolved this issue, and the mainbreaker was able to connect again to the charger.
Right now there are no error flags showing, and the issue is not live.
We will keep monitoring the charger for the next three days, to see if any error flag appears regarding this issue.
Only once the error is live, we are able to do an on-site check.
We hope to have informed you enough.
Thank you.
Kind regards,
Priscilla van Wettum

additional_info.subject: ID0483684-DC/Si-D/FR-[Y2/S2 313522141002] Fault report – Charger CRM:03056001105
additional_info.body:
Dear Malek,
Thank you for your response.
We understand your worry regarding the issue.
Sometimes it is indeed needed to perform a reboot to the charger, to make an error disappear.
Unfortunately we can`t guarantee you anything regarding errors occurring again, this depends on a lot of factors that are outside of our control.
There are no actions to be taken to prevent an error occurring.  We are able to monitor the charger the coming three days, to see if any error occurs, and if it does, we are able to send this to the regional team.
Right now the charger looks healthy and there is no sign of the mainbreaker tripping.
We will update you regarding the monitoring of the charger.
We hope to have informed you enough.
Thank you.
Kind regards,
Priscilla van Wettum
